Q: How do I run my Unity WebGL game locally for testing? A:

Regarding

that needs me to move my files to a new location every time so that'd be annoying.

If you basically already have something working and all that bothers you is moving the build files around, that part you can easily automate implementing either IPostprocessBuildWithContext or use the PostProcessBuildAttribute directly from within Unity.

That way you can let Unity do something with your build files after each build - in your case copy them into your local server testing environment

Q: Telegram Login Widget does not send the message A:

I think you should know how Telegram Login really works. The telegram login widget does not send an sms to the user's phone. Also telegram ignores redirect_url unless it matches exactly the domain configured in BotFather, same scheme, same host, and same port. And telegram is extremely strict about domains.

So what to do:

  1. Verity HTTPS

    bash command:

    curl -I https://yourdomain.com

    Must return 200 with valid cert.

  2. In host Nginx, not container:

    location / {
  proxy_pass http://docker-nginx;
  proxy_set_header Host $host;
  proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto https;
  proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $remote_addr;
}

  3. Re-set BotFather domain

    In botFather, bash command:

    /setdomain yourdomain

    I think you should wait 1~2 minutes.

  4. Test with your telegram desktop or mobile. Telegram Login will not work if:

    • User is loggest out
    • Browser blocks popups
    • Telegram app not available

Once the domain, headers, and HTTPS are correct, Telegram Login becomes reliable.
